"I am Physiotherapist" is an educational YouTube channel created and hosted by Dr. Kaiynat Shafiq, an Orthopedic manual physiotherapist.

This channel is dedicated to providing high-quality, informative & engaging content related to physiotherapy.

Through my expertise, I offer viewers an opportunity to learn about various aspects of physiotherapy. 
The channel covers a wide range of topics related to physiotherapy, such as rehabilitation after injuries, managing chronic pain & maintaining a healthy lifestyle.

With a focus on providing evidence-based information, "I am Physiotherapist" aims to be a reliable source, for anyone interested in learning more about physiotherapy. Whether you are a healthcare professional, student, or simply someone looking to improve your physical health, this channel provides valuable insights & practical advice to help you achieve your goals.

In case of any queries, suggestions or complains, you can contact me here
